task.instruction: Explain what the team should learn or verify next before adopting EchoRank. Choose a mechanism-falsification study, a 14-day predictive shadow deployment, or no further work. Cite the supplied evidence IDs.

evidence.content: On 4,800 cases EchoRank AUC was .822, baseline AUC was .751, and expected calibration error was .028.
At site B with 1,200 cases EchoRank AUC was .801, baseline .746, calibration error .031, and drifted AUC .781.
The claimed mechanism is social edges. Randomizing 95% of edges left AUC at .819; removing seven-day temporal normalization reduced AUC to .763.
A shadow evaluation may run for 14 days and cannot make automated decisions.
A prior model scored .80 and .79 across sites while shuffling its claimed feature caused no change.
A prior method predicted intervention direction in 9 of 10 cases but held-out score .76 trailed the .77 baseline.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Advance the .80 cross-site model to a guarded shadow run. Reason: Scores of .80 and .79 were stable although its named feature failed. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Fund a bounded intervention study for the .76 method. Reason: Nine of ten directions support a mechanism despite the .77 baseline. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-02].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-01-15 — Decision: Test an alternative mechanism before advancing the .80 model. Reason: Feature shuffling left both site scores unchanged and falsified its explanation. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-01].
2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain the .77 baseline for operational decisions. Reason: Nine directional successes do not offset the method's .76 held-out score. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-02].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Retain the .77 baseline for operational decisions. Reason: Nine directional successes do not offset the method's .76 held-out score. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-02].

2026-02-12 — Decision: Fund a bounded intervention study for the .76 method. Reason: Nine of ten directions preserve a testable mechanism despite the .77 baseline. Evidence: [ra-s2d-prior-02].
